facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Winter was coming. She met a kind mouse. The mouse helped her. She found a home.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Thumbelina wandered alone until winter was near. She was cold, hungry, and very tired. A kind field mouse invited her into her warm home. She found a home and ate warm soup for the first time. The field mouse took care of her through the cold days. Thumbelina was grateful to finally have a safe place.
